messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: Problem: the data changes, strange behavior (Figure with ggplot2)
parts:
I think this line is probably not doing what you want it to do:
  dr[dr$canton==c(input$canton,input$canton2,input$canton3,input$canton4),]

You probably want something like this:
  dr[dr$canton %in% c(input$canton,input$canton2,input$canton3,input$canton4),]

-Winston
